parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of deconstructing Q objects with non-subscriptable children by adding a check for tuple length. It is minimal and maintains backward compatibility.

issues.description: The patch introduces a new condition that checks if the child is a tuple of length 2, which slightly deviates from the original style of the code.
